<!-- Generated from examples/agentic-city/.github/prompts/city-crisis.prompt.md by `npm run city:sync`. Edit that file, not this copy. -->

A crisis has struck Agentic City: use the crisis described after the slash command. If none was given, the Lighthouse That Winks has started winking at the moon and the tides are confused.

Convene the council. Record an emergency decision in the minutes, then delegate only to the offices the response really needs:

- the City Planner if a district or landmark must change,
- the Building Inspector if anything new or changed must be safe,
- the Treasurer for the cost of the response.

Keep the response proportionate, absurd, and legal under the charter. Report the outcome and suggest the Town Crier handoff.
